title: The relay wrapper looks up extraKnownMarketplaces.relay…
what: plugins/front/bin/relay:9: MEDIUM: F3 the relay wrapper looks up extraKnownMarketplaces.relay, but the marketplace is named amidman since 28 Oct, so it always falls back to ~/relay
why: The relay wrapper looks up extraKnownMarketplaces.relay, but the marketplace has been named amidman since 28 Oct, so it always falls back to ~/relay: on a machine where relay lives elsewhere the wrapper runs the wrong copy.
failing_case: Relay checked out at /opt/relay, `relay setup --global` run (user settings hold extraKnownMarketplaces.amidman.source.path = /opt/relay),
RELAY_ROOT unset, no ~/relay. A session's `relay ...` on PATH runs the wrapper: jq '.extraKnownMarketplaces.relay.source.path' is empty,
root = ~/relay, and it fails "relay: repository not found". Expected: it runs /opt/relay/bin/relay.
pass_cases: User settings with extraKnownMarketplaces.amidman.source.path = <dir with bin/relay>, RELAY_ROOT unset -> the wrapper execs <dir>/bin/relay.
RELAY_ROOT=<dir> set -> it uses RELAY_ROOT regardless of settings.
No settings file and ~/relay present -> falls back to ~/relay.

fact: Confirmed 30 Oct 2026 on master: plugins/front/bin/relay:9 reads .extraKnownMarketplaces.relay.source.path, while ~/.claude/settings.json names the marketplace amidman (line 26), so the lookup is always empty and the wrapper falls back to ~/relay.
